reason: Paper-only and feasible: no code, no submit, byte-identical and fail-soft are moot, and no answers gives {#37,#38}. But the table is incomplete, and two of its priority choices contradict pre-registered text. It should not be shown as written. (1) The gate is mis-sized. There are not 16 answer patterns: class C has 3 letters (a/b/c), and the pair also depends on events: V*_C exists, exp72 eligible, PORT read passes, PORT is insertion-family. Enumerating 3x2x2 answers x event states gives 144 states (scratchpad slot.py). Read literally, 78 of them have a defect. (2) 48 states: an insertion-family PORT (>62 forks or a division-add stage) always goes to OTHER, so it pairs with an insertion file, both finals carry the insertion and the no-insertion hedge is lost. The pending R12-A3 (b)/R12-A7 row says {PORT,#38} (CONTEXT l.2516). (3) 24 states: 'under (b), the next insertion file' is not conditioned on V*_C existing. With letter (b), no V*_C and an exp70b yes it gives {exp70b,#37} and drops #38, against R16AP-1 (iv), 'no V*_C -> pair unchanged'. In 3 states (b, no V*_C, no exp70b/exp72) OTHER is undefined. (4) 12 states: V*_C > exp72 unconditionally. A G2-gated exp72 at >=0.956 would lose the insertion slot, or under (c) drop out entirely, to a class-C DC threshold neighbour. That neighbour's only off-public evidence is adverse (6bba dc0.20 -0.0008; dc0.30 lab/public sign flip). R13-A3 pre-registered {exp72,#38} for 'above any V*'. (5) 16 states: (b)+PORT gives {V*_C,PORT}, overriding the letter's own 'keep the L9 insertion final'. VALUE: a collision needs two rare events: V*_C ~0.15-0.25 with a pre-12:00Z (b)/(c) letter, PORT ~5%, exp72 eligible ~0.03-0.05. The one plausible collision, exp70b yes + class C (b), is already resolved by R15-A1 (4)(b) '(#37 or exp70b)' and card R16AP-1 (iii). No user answer has arrived since the 07:45Z brief, and the class-C and E10 v2 windows close ~12:00Z. Expected private gain ~0. A 4-level table sent to a user who has not answered one question adds the mis-read risk that R16AP-8 guards against.
fix: Drop the unified table. Attach two narrow clauses to the existing cards, logged only with the relevant letter. (A) With an exp70b yes: '#37' in E10 V4/v1 P6 means exp70b, ONLY for a no-insertion port (<=62 forks on the 4 dummy clips, no division-add stage). An insertion-family port keeps the R12-A7 open row: notify and ask the user. (B) If a PORT read passes while a class-C (b)/(c) re-tick is pending or done, or an eligible exp72 meets V*_C: no mechanical rule; push the facts (displays, fork counts, which file carries the insertion) and let the user choose in one message (P of any such event is ~<2%). Keep R15-A1 (4)(iv) and R13-A3 {exp72,#38} verbatim. If a table is still wanted, condition the (b) clause on V*_C existing, send insertion-family PORTs to {PORT,#38}, order the insertion slot exp72 (eligible) > V*_C, and check the full 144 states by script, not '16 patterns'.
realistic_gain: ~0 on private and public: it only removes paperwork ambiguity in states with P ~<2% combined. It is negative if shown as written: in 78 of 144 literal states it gives a pair that contradicts pre-registered text (lost insertion hedge, #38 dropped without V*_C, G2-gated exp72 displaced).
